class DataAgent(Agent):
    role = 'data validation and design inspection'

    def run(self):
        self.think('Validate the data set and identify the experimental design before any modelling is attempted.')
        df = self.use('load_dataset')
        prof = self.use('profile_dataset', df=df)
        design = self.use('inspect_design', df=df)
        self.observe(f"{len(df)} runs, {len(FACTORS)} factors x 3 levels, {len(RESPONSES)} responses; design: {design['design']}; "
                     f"balanced = {design['balanced']}; max |r| between factors = {design['max_abs_factor_corr']:.2e}")
        outl = self.use('screen_outliers', df=df)
        self.observe(f'Robust outlier screen (|modified z| > 3.5): {len(outl)} flagged value(s).')
        ctx = {'n_runs': len(df), 'n_factors': len(FACTORS)}
        self.decide('Which validation protocol is appropriate?', ctx,
                    ['LOOCV + repeated k-fold tuning + nested-CV audit', '70/30 hold-out split'],
                    lambda c: ('LOOCV + repeated k-fold tuning + nested-CV audit',
                               f"n = {c['n_runs']} < 50: a hold-out split would test on ~8 runs and give a high-variance "
                               'estimate; LOOCV uses every run once for testing and nested CV removes tuning optimism'))
        for k, v in [('data', df), ('profile', prof), ('design', design), ('outliers', outl)]:
            self.bb.post(k, v, self.name)
        return {'status': 'ok'}


class MCDMAgent(Agent):
    role = 'multi-criteria decision making (TOPSIS)'

    def run(self):
        df = self.bb['data'].copy()
        self.think('Aggregate the conflicting responses into one TOPSIS closeness coefficient '
                   '(Ra and TWR are cost criteria, MRR is a benefit criterion).')
        D = df[RESPONSES].values.astype(float)
        w_user = np.asarray(self.cfg.topsis_weights, float) / np.sum(self.cfg.topsis_weights)
        C, ref = self.use('topsis', D=D, weights=w_user, benefit=BENEFIT)
        diff = float(np.max(np.abs(C - np.asarray(USER_TOPSIS))))
        self.observe(f'Supplied TOPSIS scores reproduced: max |difference| = {diff:.1e} '
                     f'(weights Ra/MRR/TWR = {"/".join(f"{w:g}" for w in w_user)}, vector normalisation).')
        df['TOPSIS'] = C
        df['Rank'] = (-C).argsort().argsort() + 1
        schemes = {'User': w_user, 'Equal': np.ones(3) / 3,
                   'Entropy': self.use('entropy_weights', D=D), 'CRITIC': self.use('critic_weights', D=D, benefit=BENEFIT)}
        ranks = {}
        for k, w in schemes.items():
            c, _ = topsis(D, w, BENEFIT)
            ranks[k] = (-c).argsort().argsort() + 1
        rank_df = pd.DataFrame(ranks, index=df.Exp.values)
        tau = {k: float(stats.kendalltau(rank_df['User'], rank_df[k])[0]) for k in schemes}
        top1 = {k: int(rank_df[k].idxmin()) for k in schemes}
        ctx = {'kendall_tau_vs_user': {k: round(v, 3) for k, v in tau.items()}, 'top_ranked_run': top1}
        def robustness_rule(c):
            tops = sorted(set(c['top_ranked_run'].values()))
            tau_min = min(c['kendall_tau_vs_user'].values())
            reasons = []
            if len(tops) > 1:
                reasons.append(f'the top-ranked run differs between weighting schemes (runs {tops})')
            if tau_min < 0.9:
                reasons.append(f'rank agreement between schemes is imperfect (min Kendall tau = {tau_min:.2f} < 0.90)')
            if not reasons:
                return 'no', 'all weighting schemes agree'
            note = f'; run {tops[0]} is ranked first under every scheme' if len(tops) == 1 else ''
            return 'yes', ' and '.join(reasons) + note

        need = self.decide('Is a stochastic weight-robustness (rank-acceptability) analysis required?', ctx, ['yes', 'no'],
                           robustness_rule)
        acc = None
        if need == 'yes':
            acc = self.use('rank_acceptability', D=D, benefit=BENEFIT, n_samples=20000, seed=self.cfg.seed)
            b = acc.sort_values('P(rank 1)', ascending=False)
            self.reflect(f"Run {int(b.iloc[0].Exp)} is ranked first for {100 * b.iloc[0]['P(rank 1)']:.1f}% of 20,000 random weight "
                         f"vectors, run {int(b.iloc[1].Exp)} for {100 * b.iloc[1]['P(rank 1)']:.1f}%; the preferred region "
                         'is robust to the choice of weights.')
        for k, v in [('data', df), ('topsis_ref', ref), ('topsis_check', diff),
                     ('weight_schemes', pd.DataFrame(schemes, index=RESPONSES).T), ('scheme_ranks', rank_df),
                     ('scheme_tau', tau), ('rank_acceptability', acc)]:
            self.bb.post(k, v, self.name)
        return {'status': 'ok'}


class DoEAgent(Agent):
    role = 'statistical design-of-experiments analysis'

    def run(self):
        df = self.bb['data']
        self.think('Quantify factor effects with main-effects ANOVA (exact for this balanced orthogonal design) '
                   'and test the EDM knowledge base against the data.')
        anova = {t: self.use('anova', df=df, factors=FACTORS, response=t) for t in TARGETS}
        me = {t: self.use('main_effects', df=df, factors=FACTORS, response=t) for t in TARGETS}
        corr = self.use('correlation_screen', df=df, outputs=TARGETS)
        for t in TARGETS:
            a = anova[t].iloc[:len(FACTORS)]
            sig = a[a.p < 0.05].sort_values('Contribution (%)', ascending=False)
            self.observe(f"{t}: main-effects R2 = {anova[t].attrs['R2']:.3f}; significant (p<0.05): "
                         + ', '.join(f"{s} ({c:.1f}%)" for s, c in zip(sig.Source, sig['Contribution (%)'])))
        rows = []
        for resp, fac, sign, why in EDM_KNOWLEDGE_BASE:
            p = float(anova[resp].set_index('Source').loc[fac, 'p'])
            lv = me[resp][me[resp].Factor == fac]
            slope = float(np.polyfit(lv.Level.values.astype(float), lv.Mean.values, 1)[0])
            if p < 0.05 and np.sign(slope) == sign:
                status = 'consensus (enforced)'
            elif p < 0.05:
                status = 'conflict (expert review)'
            else:
                status = 'insufficient evidence (not enforced)'
            rows.append(dict(Response=resp, Factor=fac, Expected='+' if sign > 0 else '-', Slope=slope, p=p,
                             Status=status, Rationale=why))
        kb = pd.DataFrame(rows)
        consensus = [r for r, s in zip(EDM_KNOWLEDGE_BASE, kb.Status) if s.startswith('consensus')]
        self.reflect(f'{len(consensus)} of {len(EDM_KNOWLEDGE_BASE)} knowledge-base relations are statistically supported and '
                     'will be enforced by the Critic: ' + '; '.join(f"{r[0]}-{r[1]} ({'+' if r[2] > 0 else '-'})" for r in consensus))
        for k, v in [('anova', anova), ('main_effects', me), ('correlations', corr), ('kb_status', kb),
                     ('kb_consensus', consensus)]:
            self.bb.post(k, v, self.name)
        return {'status': 'ok'}


class AutoMLAgent(Agent):
    role = 'automated machine learning (surrogate modelling)'

    def _xy(self, t):
        df = self.bb['data']
        return df[FACTORS].values.astype(float), df[t].values.astype(float)

    def run(self):
        n = len(self.bb['data'])
        self.think('Build surrogate models f(Ton, Toff, LV, HV, FP) for Ra, MRR, TWR and the TOPSIS closeness.')
        compatible = [k for k, v in ALGORITHM_LIBRARY.items() if v['min_n'] <= n and (v.get('requires') != 'xgboost' or HAS_XGB)]
        presets = {'all compatible algorithms': compatible,
                   'compact portfolio': [a for a in ['PR2', 'SVR', 'GPR', 'RF', 'XGB', 'ANN'] if a in compatible]}
        ctx = {'n_runs': n, 'min_n_by_algorithm': {k: v['min_n'] for k, v in ALGORITHM_LIBRARY.items()},
               'presets': presets, 'compute_budget': 'small (27 runs)'}
        excluded = [k for k in ALGORITHM_LIBRARY if k not in compatible]
        choice = self.decide('Which candidate algorithm portfolio should be explored?', ctx, list(presets),
                             lambda c: ('all compatible algorithms',
                                        f"capability matching: {len(compatible)} algorithms are compatible with n = {n}; "
                                        f"excluded {excluded} (minimum sample size not met); compute cost is negligible, "
                                        'so the full compatible portfolio is explored'))
        portfolio = presets[choice]
        jobs = []
        for ti, t in enumerate(TARGETS):
            X, y = self._xy(t)
            for ai, a in enumerate(portfolio):
                jobs.append(dict(target=t, algo=a, X=X, y=y, seed=self.cfg.seed + 100 * ti + ai, n_trials=self.cfg.n_trials,
                                 n_splits=self.cfg.cv_splits, n_repeats=self.cfg.cv_repeats))
        self.think(f'Launch {len(jobs)} tuning jobs ({len(portfolio)} algorithms x {len(TARGETS)} targets; '
                   f'{self.cfg.n_trials} TPE trials each; objective = {self.cfg.cv_repeats}x{self.cfg.cv_splits}-fold CV RMSE).')
        results = self.use('automl_parallel', jobs=jobs)
        models = {t: {} for t in TARGETS}
        for r in results:
            r['round'] = 0
            models[r['target']][r['algo']] = r
        self.bb.post('portfolio', portfolio, self.name)
        self.bb.post('models', models, self.name)
        self.bb.post('model_history', results, self.name)
        best = {t: max(models[t].values(), key=lambda r: r['Q2']) for t in TARGETS}
        self.reflect('Highest Q2 before critique: ' + '; '.join(f"{t}: {b['algo']} ({b['Q2']:.3f})" for t, b in best.items()))
        return {'status': 'ok'}

    def refine(self, requests, iteration):
        portfolio = self.bb['portfolio']
        jobs = []
        for rq in requests:
            X, y = self._xy(rq['target'])
            jobs.append(dict(target=rq['target'], algo=rq['algo'], X=X, y=y,
                             seed=self.cfg.seed + 100 * TARGETS.index(rq['target']) + portfolio.index(rq['algo']),
                             n_trials=self.cfg.n_trials, n_splits=self.cfg.cv_splits, n_repeats=self.cfg.cv_repeats,
                             mode=rq['mode'], monotone=rq.get('monotone')))
        self.think(f'Reflection round {iteration}: re-tune {len(jobs)} flagged model(s) in the more conservative search '
                   'spaces requested by the Critic.')
        results = self.use('automl_parallel', jobs=jobs)
        for r in results:
            r['round'] = iteration
        self.bb.post('refined_candidates', results, self.name)
        self.bb['model_history'].extend(results)
        return {'status': 'ok'}


def audit_record(rec, X, lhs, y_obs, relations, cfg):
    """Critic diagnostics of one model: under/over-fitting, plausibility over the design space, physics consistency."""
    f = rec['model'].predict
    pl = plausibility(f, lhs, y_obs, cfg.oob_margin)
    phys = physics_consistency(f, X, relations) if relations else []
    flags = []
    if rec['Q2'] < cfg.thr_underfit_q2:
        flags.append('underfit')
    if rec['gap'] > cfg.thr_overfit_gap:
        flags.append('overfit')
    if pl['oob'] > cfg.thr_oob:
        flags.append('implausible')
    if phys and not all(p['ok'] for p in phys):
        flags.append('physics')
    return dict(oob=pl['oob'], pred_min=pl['pred_min'], pred_max=pl['pred_max'], band=(pl['lo'], pl['hi']),
                physics_score=float(np.mean([p['ok'] for p in phys])) if phys else np.nan, physics=phys, flags=flags)


class CriticAgent(Agent):
    role = 'reflection: model audit and re-training requests'
    MODES = {0: 'regularize', 1: 'strong'}

    def _diag(self, rec, X, lhs):
        rel = [r for r in self.bb['kb_consensus'] if r[0] == rec['target']]
        return self.use('model_audit', rec=rec, X=X, lhs=lhs, y_obs=self.bb['data'][rec['target']].values,
                        relations=rel, cfg=self.cfg)

    def run(self, iteration=0):
        df = self.bb['data']
        X = df[FACTORS].values.astype(float)
        models = self.bb['models']
        lhs = self.use('lhs_probe', n=self.cfg.n_lhs, seed=self.cfg.seed)
        log = self.bb.get('critic_log') or []
        if iteration == 0:
            self.think(f'Audit every surrogate: Q2 < {self.cfg.thr_underfit_q2} (under-fit), R2_train - Q2 > '
                       f'{self.cfg.thr_overfit_gap} (over-fit), > {100 * self.cfg.thr_oob:.0f}% of {self.cfg.n_lhs} Latin-hypercube '
                       'probes outside the plausible band (implausible extrapolation) and violated knowledge-base relations.')
        else:
            self.think(f'Reflection round {iteration}: compare re-trained candidates with the incumbent models.')
            for new in self.bb['refined_candidates']:
                t, a = new['target'], new['algo']
                old = models[t][a]
                new['diag'] = self._diag(new, X, lhs)
                fo, fn = old['diag']['flags'], new['diag']['flags']
                accept = (len(fn) < len(fo) and new['RMSE'] <= 1.10 * old['RMSE']) or (len(fn) <= len(fo) and new['RMSE'] < old['RMSE'])
                verdict = 'accepted' if accept else 'rejected'
                self.reflect(f"{a} for {t}: refinement {verdict} (flags {fo or ['none']} -> {fn or ['none']}; "
                             f"Q2 {old['Q2']:.3f} -> {new['Q2']:.3f}; RMSE {old['RMSE']:.4g} -> {new['RMSE']:.4g})")
                log.append(dict(round=iteration, target=t, algo=a, mode=new['mode'], monotone=new['monotone'],
                                flags_before=','.join(fo), flags_after=','.join(fn), Q2_before=old['Q2'], Q2_after=new['Q2'],
                                RMSE_before=old['RMSE'], RMSE_after=new['RMSE'], gap_before=old['gap'], gap_after=new['gap'],
                                oob_before=old['diag']['oob'], oob_after=new['diag']['oob'], decision=verdict))
                if accept:
                    new['diag_round'] = iteration
                    models[t][a] = new
                else:
                    old['frozen'] = True
        rows = []
        for t in TARGETS:
            for a, rec in models[t].items():
                if 'diag' not in rec:
                    rec['diag'] = self._diag(rec, X, lhs)
                d = rec['diag']
                rows.append(dict(round=iteration, target=t, algo=a, mode=rec['mode'], Q2=rec['Q2'], RMSE=rec['RMSE'],
                                 MAE=rec['MAE'], MAPE=rec['MAPE'], R2_train=rec['R2_train'], gap=rec['gap'], oob=d['oob'],
                                 physics_score=d['physics_score'], flags=','.join(d['flags'])))
        table = pd.DataFrame(rows)
        rounds = self.bb.get('critic_rounds') or []
        rounds.append(table)
        self.bb.post('critic_rounds', rounds, self.name)
        self.bb.post('critic_log', log, self.name)
        counts = {k: int(table['flags'].str.contains(k).sum()) for k in ['underfit', 'overfit', 'implausible', 'physics']}
        self.observe(f'Round {iteration}: flags = {counts} over {len(table)} models.')
        mode = self.MODES.get(iteration)
        requests = []
        consensus = self.bb['kb_consensus']
        for t in TARGETS:
            for a, rec in models[t].items():
                actionable = set(rec['diag']['flags']) & {'overfit', 'implausible', 'physics'}
                if not actionable or a == 'MLR' or mode is None or rec.get('frozen'):
                    continue
                mono = rec.get('monotone')
                if 'physics' in actionable and a == 'XGB':
                    signs = {fac: s for (resp, fac, s, _) in consensus if resp == t}
                    mono = tuple(signs.get(f, 0) for f in FACTORS)
                requests.append(dict(target=t, algo=a, mode=mode, monotone=mono, reasons=sorted(actionable)))
        if requests and iteration < self.cfg.max_reflection_rounds:
            self.decide('Should flagged models be sent back for re-training?',
                        {'n_flagged': len(requests), 'round': iteration, 'max_rounds': self.cfg.max_reflection_rounds},
                        ['re-train flagged models', 'accept current models'],
                        lambda c: ('re-train flagged models', f"{c['n_flagged']} model(s) carry actionable flags and the "
                                   f"reflection budget is not exhausted (round {c['round']} of {c['max_rounds']}); "
                                   f"request '{mode}' search spaces (XGBoost: monotonic constraints for physics violations)"))
            return {'status': 'revise', 'requests': requests, 'iteration': iteration}
        self.reflect(f'Critique complete after {iteration} reflection round(s); remaining flags are handled by the selection gates.')
        return {'status': 'accept'}


class SelectionAgent(Agent):
    role = 'model selection and validation audit'
    CRITERIA = {'RMSE': (0.35, False), 'MAE': (0.15, False), 'gap': (0.20, False), 'oob': (0.10, False), 'physics_score': (0.20, True)}

    def run(self):
        df = self.bb['data']
        X = df[FACTORS].values.astype(float)
        models = self.bb['models']
        self.think('Rank audited models per target by TOPSIS over accuracy (RMSE, MAE), robustness (over-fitting gap), '
                   'plausibility and physics consistency; audit the shortlist with nested cross-validation.')
        rankings, shortlist = {}, {}
        for t in TARGETS:
            tab = pd.DataFrame([dict(algo=a, Q2=r['Q2'], RMSE=r['RMSE'], MAE=r['MAE'], MAPE=r['MAPE'], gap=r['gap'],
                                     oob=r['diag']['oob'], physics_score=r['diag']['physics_score'],
                                     flags=','.join(r['diag']['flags'])) for a, r in models[t].items()])
            tab['physics_score'] = tab['physics_score'].fillna(1.0)
            tab['gate'] = (tab.Q2 >= self.cfg.thr_underfit_q2) & (tab.oob <= self.cfg.thr_oob) & (tab.physics_score >= 1.0)
            cand = tab[tab.gate] if tab.gate.sum() >= 1 else tab
            tab['TOPSIS score'] = topsis_minmax_rank(cand, self.CRITERIA).reindex(tab.index)
            tab = tab.sort_values('TOPSIS score', ascending=False, na_position='last').reset_index(drop=True)
            rankings[t] = tab
            shortlist[t] = tab.dropna(subset=['TOPSIS score']).algo.head(self.cfg.shortlist_k).tolist()
            self.observe(f"{t}: {int(tab.gate.sum())}/{len(tab)} models pass the gates; shortlist = {shortlist[t]}")
        jobs = [dict(target=t, algo=a, X=X, y=df[t].values.astype(float), seed=self.cfg.seed + 500 + 10 * TARGETS.index(t),
                     outer_splits=self.cfg.nested_outer_splits, outer_repeats=self.cfg.nested_outer_repeats,
                     inner_trials=self.cfg.nested_inner_trials, mode=models[t][a]['mode'], monotone=models[t][a]['monotone'])
                for t in TARGETS for a in shortlist[t]]
        nested = self.use('nested_cv_parallel', jobs=jobs)
        nested_df = pd.DataFrame([{k: v for k, v in r.items() if k not in ('fold_rmse', 'preds')} for r in nested])
        nested_df['apparent_RMSE'] = [models[r['target']][r['algo']]['RMSE'] for r in nested]
        nested_df['apparent_Q2'] = [models[r['target']][r['algo']]['Q2'] for r in nested]
        nested_df['optimism (%)'] = 100 * (nested_df.nested_RMSE / nested_df.apparent_RMSE - 1)
        selected = {}
        for t in TARGETS:
            sub = nested_df[nested_df.target == t].set_index('algo')
            ctx = {a: {'Q2_LOOCV': round(models[t][a]['Q2'], 4), 'nested_RMSE': round(sub.loc[a, 'nested_RMSE'], 5),
                       'nested_R2': round(sub.loc[a, 'nested_R2'], 4), 'flags': models[t][a]['diag']['flags']} for a in shortlist[t]}
            selected[t] = self.decide(f'Which surrogate should represent {t}?', ctx, shortlist[t],
                                      lambda c: (min(c, key=lambda a: c[a]['nested_RMSE']),
                                                 'lowest nested-CV RMSE among the shortlisted, gate-passing models '
                                                 '(unbiased estimate of generalisation error)'))
        ref = self.bb['topsis_ref']
        y_t = df['TOPSIS'].values
        oof_Y = np.column_stack([np.maximum(models[r][selected[r]]['oof'], 0) for r in RESPONSES])
        ind = regression_metrics(y_t, topsis_fixed(oof_Y, ref))
        dr = models['TOPSIS'][selected['TOPSIS']]
        ctx = {'indirect (TOPSIS of predicted Ra, MRR, TWR)': {'Q2': round(ind['R2'], 4), 'RMSE': round(ind['RMSE'], 5)},
               'direct (TOPSIS surrogate)': {'Q2': round(dr['Q2'], 4), 'RMSE': round(dr['RMSE'], 5)}}
        strategy = self.decide('How should the TOPSIS objective be evaluated during optimisation?', ctx, ['indirect', 'direct'],
                               lambda c: ('indirect', 'composing the validated response surrogates is at most 10% less accurate '
                                          'than a direct TOPSIS surrogate (LOOCV RMSE), stays traceable to Ra, MRR and TWR, '
                                          'and remains valid for any preference weights without re-training')
                               if ind['RMSE'] <= 1.10 * dr['RMSE'] else
                               ('direct', 'the direct TOPSIS surrogate is more than 10% more accurate under LOOCV'))
        predictors = {r: models[r][selected[r]]['model'] for r in RESPONSES}
        composite = CompositeObjective(predictors, ref, strategy, models['TOPSIS'][selected['TOPSIS']]['model'])
        self.reflect('Selected surrogates: ' + '; '.join(f"{t}: {selected[t]} (Q2 = {models[t][selected[t]]['Q2']:.3f}, nested R2 = "
                                                       f"{nested_df[(nested_df.target == t) & (nested_df.algo == selected[t])].nested_R2.iloc[0]:.3f})"
                                                       for t in TARGETS) + f'; TOPSIS strategy = {strategy}.')
        for k, v in [('model_ranking', rankings), ('shortlist', shortlist), ('nested', nested), ('nested_table', nested_df),
                     ('selected', selected), ('strategy', dict(choice=strategy, indirect=ind,
                                                              direct=dict(R2=dr['Q2'], RMSE=dr['RMSE'], MAE=dr['MAE'], MAPE=dr['MAPE']),
                                                              indirect_oof=topsis_fixed(oof_Y, ref), direct_oof=dr['oof'])),
                     ('predictors', predictors), ('composite', composite)]:
            self.bb.post(k, v, self.name)
        return {'status': 'ok'}


class XAIAgent(Agent):
    role = 'explainable AI'

    def run(self):
        df = self.bb['data']
        X = df[FACTORS].values.astype(float)
        self.think('Explain the selected surrogates and the composite TOPSIS objective with exact interventional Shapley '
                   'values (all 2^5 = 32 coalitions, background = the 27 runs) and triangulate with ANOVA.')
        fns = {r: self.bb['predictors'][r].predict for r in RESPONSES}
        fns['TOPSIS'] = self.bb['composite']
        shap_res, imp = {}, {}
        for t, f in fns.items():
            phi, base = self.use('exact_shapley', predict=f, X=X, Xbg=X)
            err = float(np.max(np.abs(phi.sum(1) + base - f(X))))
            shap_res[t] = dict(phi=phi, base=base, X=X, additivity_error=err)
            imp[t] = np.abs(phi).mean(0)
        imp = pd.DataFrame(imp, index=FACTORS).T
        imp_pct = 100 * imp.div(imp.sum(1), axis=0)
        agree = {}
        for t in TARGETS:
            a = self.bb['anova'][t].set_index('Source').loc[FACTORS, 'Contribution (%)']
            agree[t] = float(stats.spearmanr(imp_pct.loc[t, FACTORS].values, a.values)[0])
        self.observe('Efficiency (additivity) check: max |sum(phi) + E[f] - f(x)| = '
                     f"{max(v['additivity_error'] for v in shap_res.values()):.1e}")
        self.reflect('Most influential factor (mean |SHAP|): ' + '; '.join(f'{t}: {imp_pct.loc[t].idxmax()} ({imp_pct.loc[t].max():.0f}%)'
                                                                          for t in TARGETS)
                     + '. Rank agreement with ANOVA (Spearman rho): ' + ', '.join(f'{t} {v:.2f}' for t, v in agree.items()))
        for k, v in [('shap', shap_res), ('shap_importance', imp), ('shap_importance_pct', imp_pct), ('xai_agreement', agree)]:
            self.bb.post(k, v, self.name)
        return {'status': 'ok'}


class OptimisationAgent(Agent):
    role = 'evolutionary and Bayesian optimisation'
    MOO = ['NSGA-II', 'NSGA-III', 'MOEA/D', 'SPEA2']
    SOO = ['GA', 'DE', 'PSO', 'TPE-BO', 'Random search']

    def _norm_bounds(self):
        Y = self.bb['data'][RESPONSES].values
        return (np.array([Y[:, 0].min(), -Y[:, 1].max(), Y[:, 2].min()]),
                np.array([Y[:, 0].max(), -Y[:, 1].min(), Y[:, 2].max()]))

    def _pareto_frame(self, runs):
        X = np.vstack([r['X'] for r in runs if len(r['X'])])
        F = np.vstack([r['F'] for r in runs if len(r['F'])])
        X, idx = np.unique(np.round(X, 8), axis=0, return_index=True)
        F = F[idx]
        nd = non_dominated(F)
        P = pd.DataFrame(X[nd], columns=FACTORS)
        P['Ra'], P['MRR'], P['TWR'] = F[nd, 0], -F[nd, 1], F[nd, 2]
        P['TOPSIS (fixed ref.)'] = topsis_fixed(P[RESPONSES].values, self.bb['topsis_ref'])
        return P.sort_values('Ra').reset_index(drop=True)

    def run(self):
        preds = self.bb['predictors']
        ideal, nadir = self._norm_bounds()
        ref_dirs = get_reference_directions('das-dennis', 3, n_partitions=self.cfg.moo_partitions)
        pop = len(ref_dirs) + (-len(ref_dirs)) % 4
        self.think(f'Approximate the Pareto front of (min Ra, max MRR, min TWR) with {len(self.MOO)} multi-objective EAs '
                   f'({self.cfg.moo_seeds} seeds, population {pop}, {self.cfg.moo_gens} generations) and benchmark '
                   f'{len(self.SOO)} single-objective optimisers on the TOPSIS objective ({self.cfg.soo_budget} evaluations).')
        jobs = [dict(alg=a, seed=self.cfg.seed + s, predictors=preds, ideal=ideal, nadir=nadir, n_gen=self.cfg.moo_gens,
                     ref_dirs=ref_dirs, pop=pop) for a in self.MOO for s in range(self.cfg.moo_seeds)]
        runs = self.use('moo_parallel', jobs=jobs)
        hv = {a: np.array([r['hv'][-1] for r in runs if r['alg'] == a]) for a in self.MOO}
        st = pd.DataFrame({a: dict(HV_mean=v.mean(), HV_sd=v.std(ddof=1) if len(v) > 1 else 0.0, HV_median=np.median(v),
                                   HV_IQR=np.subtract(*np.percentile(v, [75, 25])),
                                   n_nondominated=np.mean([len(r['F']) for r in runs if r['alg'] == a]),
                                   evaluations=np.mean([r['nevals'][-1] for r in runs if r['alg'] == a]),
                                   time_s=np.mean([r['time_s'] for r in runs if r['alg'] == a])) for a, v in hv.items()}).T
        kw = stats.kruskal(*hv.values()) if self.cfg.moo_seeds > 2 else None
        best = self.decide('Which multi-objective optimiser performs best on this problem?',
                           {a: {'median_HV': round(float(st.loc[a, 'HV_median']), 5), 'mean_time_s': round(float(st.loc[a, 'time_s']), 2)} for a in self.MOO},
                           self.MOO, lambda c: (max(c, key=lambda a: (c[a]['median_HV'], -c[a]['mean_time_s'])),
                                                'highest median final hypervolume (ties broken by run time)'))
        tests = []
        for a in self.MOO:
            if a != best and self.cfg.moo_seeds > 2:
                tests.append(dict(comparison=f'{best} vs {a}', p=float(stats.mannwhitneyu(hv[best], hv[a], alternative='two-sided').pvalue)))
        tests = pd.DataFrame(tests)
        if len(tests):
            order = np.argsort(tests.p.values)
            adj = np.empty(len(tests))
            m = len(tests)
            running = 0.0
            for rank, i in enumerate(order):                       # Holm step-down adjustment
                running = max(running, min(1.0, (m - rank) * tests.p.values[i]))
                adj[i] = running
            tests['p_Holm'] = adj
        pareto = self._pareto_frame(runs)
        if kw is not None:
            self.observe(f'Kruskal-Wallis test on final hypervolume across optimisers: H = {kw.statistic:.2f}, p = {kw.pvalue:.3g}.')
        self.observe(f'Reference Pareto set: {len(pareto)} non-dominated solutions pooled from {len(runs)} runs; '
                     f"Ra {pareto.Ra.min():.2f}-{pareto.Ra.max():.2f} µm, MRR {pareto.MRR.min():.3f}-{pareto.MRR.max():.3f} mm³/min.")
        strat = self.bb['strategy']['choice']
        direct = self.bb['models']['TOPSIS'][self.bb['selected']['TOPSIS']]['model']
        sjobs = [dict(alg=a, seed=self.cfg.seed + s, predictors=preds, ref=self.bb['topsis_ref'], strategy=strat,
                      direct_model=direct, budget=self.cfg.soo_budget, pop=self.cfg.soo_pop)
                 for a in self.SOO for s in range(self.cfg.soo_seeds)]
        sruns = self.use('soo_parallel', jobs=sjobs)
        g_best = max(r['best'] for r in sruns)
        srows = {}
        for a in self.SOO:
            rr = [r for r in sruns if r['alg'] == a]
            fin = np.array([r['best'] for r in rr])
            hit = [int(np.argmax(r['curve'] >= 0.99 * g_best)) + 1 if r['curve'].max() >= 0.99 * g_best else np.nan for r in rr]
            srows[a] = dict(best_mean=fin.mean(), best_sd=fin.std(ddof=1) if len(fin) > 1 else 0.0, best_max=fin.max(),
                            success_rate=float(np.mean(~np.isnan(hit))), evals_to_99pct=float(np.nanmedian(hit)) if np.any(~np.isnan(hit)) else np.nan,
                            time_s=np.mean([r['time_s'] for r in rr]))
        sst = pd.DataFrame(srows).T
        skw = stats.kruskal(*[[r['best'] for r in sruns if r['alg'] == a] for a in self.SOO]) if self.cfg.soo_seeds > 2 else None
        self.reflect(f'Best TOPSIS objective found = {g_best:.4f}; most sample-efficient single-objective optimiser: '
                     f"{sst.evals_to_99pct.idxmin() if sst.evals_to_99pct.notna().any() else 'n/a'}; "
                     f"multi-objective winner: {best}.")
        for k, v in [('moo_runs', runs), ('moo_stats', st), ('moo_kruskal', kw), ('moo_tests', tests), ('moo_best', best),
                     ('pareto', pareto), ('moo_norm', (ideal, nadir)), ('soo_runs', sruns), ('soo_stats', sst),
                     ('soo_kruskal', skw), ('soo_global_best', g_best)]:
            self.bb.post(k, v, self.name)
        return {'status': 'ok'}

    def run_constrained(self):
        ad = self.bb['ad']
        ideal, nadir = self._norm_bounds()
        ref_dirs = get_reference_directions('das-dennis', 3, n_partitions=self.cfg.moo_partitions)
        pop = len(ref_dirs) + (-len(ref_dirs)) % 4
        alg = self.bb['moo_best']
        self.think(f'Re-optimise with {alg} subject to the applicability-domain constraint d_kNN(x) <= {ad.threshold:.3f}.')
        jobs = [dict(alg=alg, seed=self.cfg.seed + s, predictors=self.bb['predictors'], ideal=ideal, nadir=nadir,
                     n_gen=self.cfg.moo_gens, ref_dirs=ref_dirs, pop=pop, ad=ad) for s in range(self.cfg.moo_seeds)]
        runs = self.use('moo_parallel', jobs=jobs)
        P = self._pareto_frame(runs)
        P = P[ad.inside(P[FACTORS].values)].reset_index(drop=True)
        self.observe(f'Constrained Pareto set: {len(P)} solutions inside the applicability domain.')
        self.bb.post('pareto_ad', P, self.name)
        self.bb.post('moo_runs_ad', runs, self.name)
        return {'status': 'ok'}


class DecisionAgent(Agent):
    role = 'a-posteriori decision making'

    def run(self, constrained=False):
        P = self.bb['pareto_ad'] if constrained else self.bb['pareto']
        preds = self.bb['predictors']
        df = self.bb['data']
        D_exp = df[RESPONSES].values.astype(float)
        self.think(f"Score the {len(P)} Pareto-optimal solutions with TOPSIS against the FIXED ideal/anti-ideal of the "
                   f"experimental runs (no rank reversal; directly comparable with the experimental ranking) under "
                   f"{len(self.cfg.scenarios)} preference scenarios, then snap the choices to the machine set-point resolution.")
        F = P[RESPONSES].values
        comp = self.bb['composite']                  # evaluator of the decision maker's TOPSIS objective (strategy-aware)
        w_user = np.asarray(self.cfg.topsis_weights, float) / np.sum(self.cfg.topsis_weights)
        rows = []
        for sc, w in self.cfg.scenarios.items():
            w = np.asarray(w, float) / np.sum(w)
            C_exp, ref_s = self.use('topsis', D=D_exp, weights=w, benefit=BENEFIT)
            user_pref = bool(np.allclose(w, w_user))
            score = (lambda X, Y: comp(X)) if (user_pref and comp.strategy == 'direct') else (lambda X, Y: topsis_fixed(Y, ref_s))
            C = score(P[FACTORS].values, F)
            i = int(np.argmax(C))
            x = P[FACTORS].values[i]
            xs = snap_to_machine(x)
            ys = predict_responses(preds, xs[None])[0]
            j = int(np.argmax(C_exp))
            row = dict(Scenario=sc, w_Ra=w[0], w_MRR=w[1], w_TWR=w[2])
            row.update({f'{f} (cont.)': x[k] for k, f in enumerate(FACTORS)})
            row.update({f: xs[k] for k, f in enumerate(FACTORS)})
            row.update(dict(Ra=ys[0], MRR=ys[1], TWR=ys[2],
                            **{'Scenario score': float(score(xs[None], ys[None])[0]),
                               'TOPSIS': float(comp(xs[None])[0]),
                               'Best exp. run': int(df.Exp.iloc[j]), 'Best exp. score': float(C_exp[j]),
                               'pareto_index': i}))
            rows.append(row)
        rec = pd.DataFrame(rows)
        head = self.decide('Which scenario defines the headline recommendation?',
                           {'scenarios': list(self.cfg.scenarios), 'user_weights': self.cfg.topsis_weights},
                           list(self.cfg.scenarios),
                           lambda c: ('Balanced', 'its weights (0.4/0.4/0.2) are those the decision maker used to rank the '
                                                  'experimental runs, so the recommendation is directly comparable'))
        h = rec[rec.Scenario == head].iloc[0]
        self.reflect(f"Headline ({head}): " + ', '.join(f'{f} = {h[f]:g}' for f in FACTORS)
                     + f" -> predicted Ra = {h.Ra:.2f} µm, MRR = {h.MRR:.3f} mm³/min, TWR = {h.TWR:.4f} mm³/min, "
                     f"TOPSIS = {h.TOPSIS:.3f} (best experimental run {int(h['Best exp. run'])}: {h['Best exp. score']:.3f}). "
                     + '; '.join(f"{r.Scenario}: score {r['Scenario score']:.3f} vs best run {int(r['Best exp. run'])} "
                                 f"{r['Best exp. score']:.3f}" for _, r in rec.iterrows() if r.Scenario != head))
        self.bb.post('recommendations', rec, self.name)
        self.bb.post('headline', head, self.name)
        return {'status': 'ok'}


class VerificationAgent(Agent):
    role = 'verification, uncertainty and sensitivity'

    def run(self, iteration=0):
        df = self.bb['data']
        X = df[FACTORS].values.astype(float)
        if 'ad' not in self.bb:
            self.bb.post('ad', self.use('applicability_domain', X=X, k=self.cfg.ad_k, z=self.cfg.ad_z), self.name)
        ad = self.bb['ad']
        rec = self.bb['recommendations'].copy()
        Xr = rec[FACTORS].values
        rec['AD distance'] = ad.distance(Xr)
        rec['Inside AD'] = rec['AD distance'] <= ad.threshold + 1e-12
        _, nn_idx = NearestNeighbors(n_neighbors=1).fit(to_unit(X)).kneighbors(to_unit(Xr))
        rec['Nearest run'] = df.Exp.values[nn_idx[:, 0]]
        head = self.bb['headline']
        h = rec[rec.Scenario == head].iloc[0]
        self.think('Check that the recommendations lie inside the applicability domain of the experimental data before '
                   'quantifying their uncertainty and sensitivity.')
        self.observe(f"AD threshold = {ad.threshold:.3f}; headline distance = {h['AD distance']:.3f} (nearest run {h['Nearest run']}); "
                     f"{int(rec['Inside AD'].sum())}/{len(rec)} scenario recommendations inside the AD.")
        verdict = self.decide('Is the headline recommendation inside the trusted region?',
                              {'distance': round(float(h['AD distance']), 4), 'threshold': round(ad.threshold, 4), 'round': iteration},
                              ['accept', 're-optimise inside the applicability domain'],
                              lambda c: ('accept', 'distance to the nearest experimental runs is within the applicability domain')
                              if c['distance'] <= c['threshold'] + 1e-12 or c['round'] > 0
                              else ('re-optimise inside the applicability domain', 'the setting is farther from the experiments '
                                    'than the data support; restrict the search to the applicability domain'))
        self.bb.post('recommendations', rec, self.name)
        if verdict != 'accept':
            return {'status': 'revise', 'iteration': iteration}
        # ---- bootstrap uncertainty --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        models, sel = self.bb['models'], self.bb['selected']
        x0 = Xr[rec.Scenario.values == head][0]
        grids = []
        for j in range(len(FACTORS)):
            G = np.repeat(x0[None, :], 41, axis=0)
            G[:, j] = np.linspace(LB[j], UB[j], 41)
            grids.append(G)
        queries = [Xr] + grids
        boot = {}
        for r in RESPONSES:
            m = models[r][sel[r]]
            jobs = [dict(algo=m['algo'], params=m['params'], X=X, y=df[r].values.astype(float), seed=m['seed'],
                         monotone=m['monotone'], queries=queries, b=b) for b in range(self.cfg.bootstrap_B)]
            out = self.use('bootstrap_parallel', jobs=jobs)
            boot[r] = [np.maximum(np.array([o[q] for o in out]), 0) for q in range(len(queries))]    # B x n_query
        ref = self.bb['topsis_ref']
        if self.bb['strategy']['choice'] == 'direct':           # bootstrap the direct TOPSIS surrogate itself
            m = models['TOPSIS'][sel['TOPSIS']]
            jobs = [dict(algo=m['algo'], params=m['params'], X=X, y=df['TOPSIS'].values.astype(float), seed=m['seed'],
                         monotone=m['monotone'], queries=queries, b=b) for b in range(self.cfg.bootstrap_B)]
            out = self.use('bootstrap_parallel', jobs=jobs)
            boot['TOPSIS'] = [np.array([o[q] for o in out]) for q in range(len(queries))]
        else:                                                    # propagate response uncertainty through TOPSIS
            boot['TOPSIS'] = [np.array([topsis_fixed(np.column_stack([boot[r][q][b] for r in RESPONSES]), ref)
                                        for b in range(self.cfg.bootstrap_B)]) for q in range(len(queries))]
        uq = []
        for i, sc in enumerate(rec.Scenario):
            for t in TARGETS:
                s = boot[t][0][:, i]
                nominal = float(rec.iloc[i][t])
                uq.append(dict(Scenario=sc, Response=t, Prediction=nominal, Boot_mean=s.mean(), CI_low=np.percentile(s, 2.5),
                               CI_high=np.percentile(s, 97.5), CI_half_width_pct=100 * (np.percentile(s, 97.5) - np.percentile(s, 2.5)) / 2 / abs(nominal)))
        uq = pd.DataFrame(uq)
        comp = self.bb['composite']
        oat = {}
        for j, f in enumerate(FACTORS):
            G = grids[j]
            oat[f] = dict(x=G[:, j], composite=comp(G), Y=predict_responses(self.bb['predictors'], G),
                          band=np.percentile(boot['TOPSIS'][1 + j], [2.5, 97.5], axis=0))
        # local sensitivity comparable to the baseline workflow (+-10 % of each set-point, others fixed)
        loc = []
        for j, f in enumerate(FACTORS):
            g = np.linspace(max(LB[j], 0.9 * x0[j]), min(UB[j], 1.1 * x0[j]), 21)
            G = np.repeat(x0[None, :], len(g), axis=0)
            G[:, j] = g
            c = comp(G)
            loc.append(dict(Factor=f, Minimum=c.min(), Maximum=c.max(), Range=np.ptp(c)))
        loc = pd.DataFrame(loc).sort_values('Range', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
        # ---- global sensitivity (Sobol) ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
        fns = {r: self.bb['predictors'][r].predict for r in RESPONSES}
        fns['TOPSIS'] = comp
        sobol = {t: self.use('sobol', func=f, n_base=self.cfg.sobol_N, seed=self.cfg.seed) for t, f in fns.items()}
        # ---- robustness to set-point noise (+-2 % of range, Gaussian) ----------------------------------------------
        rng = np.random.default_rng(self.cfg.seed)
        Xn = np.clip(x0 + rng.normal(0, 0.02 * (UB - LB), size=(2000, len(FACTORS))), LB, UB)
        cn = comp(Xn)
        c0 = float(comp(x0[None])[0])
        robust = dict(nominal=c0, mean=float(cn.mean()), sd=float(cn.std()), p5=float(np.percentile(cn, 5)),
                      retention=float(np.mean(cn >= 0.95 * c0)))
        hu = uq[uq.Scenario == head].set_index('Response')
        self.reflect('Headline 95% bootstrap intervals: ' + '; '.join(f"{t} [{hu.loc[t, 'CI_low']:.3g}, {hu.loc[t, 'CI_high']:.3g}]" for t in TARGETS)
                     + f". Dominant factor (Sobol S_T) for TOPSIS: {sobol['TOPSIS'].set_index('Factor').ST.idxmax()}; "
                     f"{100 * robust['retention']:.0f}% of noisy set-points keep >= 95% of the nominal TOPSIS.")
        for k, v in [('uq', uq), ('bootstrap', boot), ('oat', oat), ('local_sensitivity', loc), ('sobol', sobol),
                     ('robustness', robust), ('verification_round', iteration)]:
            self.bb.post(k, v, self.name)
        return {'status': 'accept'}


class ReportAgent(Agent):
    role = 'reporting'

    def run(self):
        self.think('Compile result tables, the agent trace and an executive summary.')
        path = self.use('export_workbook', bb=self.bb, trace=self.trace)
        rec = self.bb['recommendations']
        h = rec[rec.Scenario == self.bb['headline']].iloc[0]
        sel = self.bb['selected']
        models = self.bb['models']
        fallback = (f"Agentic EDM optimisation of Ti-6Al-4V. Surrogates: " + ', '.join(f"{t}: {sel[t]} (Q2 {models[t][sel[t]]['Q2']:.3f})" for t in TARGETS)
                    + f". Best multi-objective optimiser: {self.bb['moo_best']}. Recommended (balanced) setting: "
                    + ', '.join(f'{f} = {h[f]:g} {UNITS[f]}' for f in FACTORS)
                    + f"; predicted Ra = {h.Ra:.2f} µm, MRR = {h.MRR:.3f} mm³/min, TWR = {h.TWR:.4f} mm³/min, TOPSIS = {h.TOPSIS:.3f}.")
        summary = self.reasoner.narrate('Write a 120-word executive summary of these results:\n' + fallback, fallback)
        with open(os.path.join(self.cfg.res_dir, 'executive_summary.md'), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
            fh.write(summary + '\n')
        self.observe(f'Results written to {path}.')
        self.bb.post('summary', summary, self.name)
        return {'status': 'ok'}


def tool_export_workbook(bb, trace):
    path = os.path.join(cfg.res_dir, 'Agentic_EDM_results.xlsx')
    sheets = {
        'Data_TOPSIS': bb['data'],
        'Weight_schemes': bb['weight_schemes'].reset_index(names='Scheme'),
        'Scheme_ranks': bb['scheme_ranks'].reset_index(names='Exp'),
        'Rank_acceptability': bb['rank_acceptability'] if bb['rank_acceptability'] is not None else pd.DataFrame(),
        'KB_status': bb['kb_status'],
        'Critic_round0': bb['critic_rounds'][0],
        'Critic_final': bb['critic_rounds'][-1],
        'Critic_actions': pd.DataFrame(bb['critic_log']),
        'Nested_CV': bb['nested_table'],
        'MOO_stats': bb['moo_stats'].reset_index(names='Algorithm'),
        'MOO_tests': bb['moo_tests'],
        'SOO_stats': bb['soo_stats'].reset_index(names='Algorithm'),
        'Pareto_set': bb['pareto'],
        'Recommendations': bb['recommendations'],
        'Uncertainty': bb['uq'],
        'Local_sensitivity': bb['local_sensitivity'],
        'SHAP_importance_pct': bb['shap_importance_pct'].reset_index(names='Target'),
        'Agent_decisions': trace.frame().query("kind == 'DECISION'")[['t', 'agent', 'question', 'choice', 'rationale', 'source']],
        'Agent_trace': trace.frame()[['t', 'agent', 'kind', 'content', 'duration']],
    }
    for t in TARGETS:
        sheets[f'ANOVA_{t}'] = bb['anova'][t]
        sheets[f'Ranking_{t}'] = bb['model_ranking'][t]
        sheets[f'Sobol_{t}'] = bb['sobol'][t]
    with pd.ExcelWriter(path) as xw:
        for name, d in sheets.items():
            d.to_excel(xw, sheet_name=name[:31], index=False)
    trace.frame().to_json(os.path.join(cfg.res_dir, 'agent_trace.json'), orient='records', indent=1, default_handler=str)
    return path


def finalise_trace_export(trace):
    """Re-write the trace files once the run has ended, so that they also contain the events logged after the
    Report agent's export (its own action, observation and the closing reflection)."""
    frame = trace.frame()
    frame.to_json(os.path.join(cfg.res_dir, 'agent_trace.json'), orient='records', indent=1, default_handler=str)
    path = os.path.join(cfg.res_dir, 'Agentic_EDM_results.xlsx')
    if os.path.exists(path):
        with pd.ExcelWriter(path, mode='a', engine='openpyxl', if_sheet_exists='replace') as xw:
            frame.query("kind == 'DECISION'")[['t', 'agent', 'question', 'choice', 'rationale', 'source']].to_excel(
                xw, sheet_name='Agent_decisions', index=False)
            frame[['t', 'agent', 'kind', 'content', 'duration']].to_excel(xw, sheet_name='Agent_trace', index=False)
    return len(frame)

6. Assemble the agentic system and run it¶

The Orchestrator receives a natural-language goal, builds the task graph and dispatches the agents. The printed log is the agents' reasoning trace (thoughts, decisions and reflections); actions and observations are stored in the trace. Set LOAD_CACHED = True to reload a previous run (e.g. when only re-styling figures).

In [11]:

    ('soo_parallel', lambda jobs: run_parallel(soo_job, jobs, cfg.n_jobs), 'GA / DE / PSO / TPE-BO / random search runs (parallel)'),
    ('applicability_domain', ApplicabilityDomain, 'k-NN distance-based applicability domain'),
    ('bootstrap_parallel', lambda jobs: run_parallel(bootstrap_job, jobs, cfg.n_jobs), 'Bootstrap refits for uncertainty (parallel)'),
    ('sobol', sobol_indices, 'Sobol first- and total-order indices with bootstrap CIs'),
    ('export_workbook', tool_export_workbook, 'Write the results workbook and agent trace'),
]:
    tools.register(name, fn, desc)

agents = {k: cls(nm, bb, tools, reasoner, trace, cfg) for k, cls, nm in [
    ('data', DataAgent, 'Data'), ('mcdm', MCDMAgent, 'MCDM'), ('doe', DoEAgent, 'DoE'), ('automl', AutoMLAgent, 'AutoML'),
    ('critic', CriticAgent, 'Critic'), ('selection', SelectionAgent, 'Selection'), ('xai', XAIAgent, 'XAI'),
    ('optimisation', OptimisationAgent, 'Optimisation'), ('decision', DecisionAgent, 'Decision'),
    ('verification', VerificationAgent, 'Verification'), ('report', ReportAgent, 'Report')]}
orchestrator = Orchestrator('Orchestrator', bb, tools, reasoner, trace, cfg, agents=agents)

GOAL = ('Recommend EDM settings for Ti-6Al-4V that minimise Ra and TWR and maximise MRR, using validated, '
        'physically plausible and explainable surrogate models; quantify uncertainty and sensitivity.')

if LOAD_CACHED and os.path.exists(CACHE):
    cached = joblib.load(CACHE)
    bb.data, trace.events = cached['bb'], cached['trace']
    print(f'Loaded cached run from {CACHE}')
else:
    t_start = time.perf_counter()
    orchestrator.run(GOAL)
    print(f'\nAgentic workflow finished in {time.perf_counter() - t_start:.1f} s')
    joblib.dump({'bb': bb.data, 'trace': trace.events}, CACHE, compress=3)
    print(f'Complete agent trace ({finalise_trace_export(trace)} events) written to {cfg.res_dir}')

print('\nReasoning engine:', reasoner.name)
print(tools.describe().to_string(index=False))

  rank_acceptability        Monte-Carlo rank acceptability over the weight simplex
               anova                             Main-effects analysis of variance

           lhs_probe                    Latin-hypercube probes of the design space

applicability_domain                      k-NN distance-based applicability domain

Fig. 1 – Architecture of the agentic AI framework¶

In [13]:
def draw_box(ax, x, y, w, h, title, body=None, fc='#ffffff', ec=AXIS, lw=0.8, title_size=7.2, body_size=6.0, bold=True):
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x, y), w, h, boxstyle='round,pad=0.25,rounding_size=0.9', fc=fc, ec=ec, lw=lw, zorder=2))
    if body:
        ax.text(x + w / 2, y + h * 0.66, title, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=title_size,
                fontweight='bold' if bold else 'normal', color=INK, zorder=3)
        ax.text(x + w / 2, y + h * 0.28, body, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=body_size, color=INK2, zorder=3,
                linespacing=1.15)
    else:
        ax.text(x + w / 2, y + h / 2, title, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=title_size,
                fontweight='bold' if bold else 'normal', color=INK, zorder=3)


def arrow(ax, p0, p1, color=INK2, lw=0.8, style='-|>', rad=0.0, ls='-', ms=6):
    ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch(p0, p1, arrowstyle=style, mutation_scale=ms, color=color, lw=lw, linestyle=ls,
                                 connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}', zorder=1.5, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0))


def tint(hex_color, a=0.13):
    r, g, b = to_rgb(hex_color)
    return (1 - a + a * r, 1 - a + a * g, 1 - a + a * b)

          ('Act', PALETTE[3], [('Optimisation agent', 'NSGA-II/III · MOEA/D\nSPEA2 · GA · DE\nPSO · TPE-BO'), ('Decision agent', 'fixed-reference\nTOPSIS · scenarios')]),
          ('Assure', PALETTE[4], [('Verification agent', 'applicability domain\nbootstrap UQ\nSobol · robustness')]),

fb = bb['critic_rounds'][-1]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(W2, W2 * 0.42))
for ax, M, title, cmap, fmt, lab, vmin, vmax in [
        (axes[0], Q, 'Q² (leave-one-out R²)', SEQ_LIGHT, '{:.2f}', '(a)', min(0.0, np.nanmin(Q.values)), 1.0),
        (axes[1], NR, 'Normalised LOOCV RMSE (% of range)', SEQ_LIGHT.reversed(), '{:.1f}', '(b)', 0, np.nanmax(NR.values))]:
    im = ax.imshow(M.values.astype(float), cmap=cmap, vmin=vmin, vmax=vmax, aspect='auto')
    ax.grid(False)
    ax.set_xticks(range(len(TARGETS)), [SHORT[t] for t in TARGETS])
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(algos)), algos, fontsize=6.5)
    norm = Normalize(vmin, vmax)
    for i in range(len(algos)):
        for j, t in enumerate(TARGETS):
            v = M.values[i, j]
            light = norm(v) > 0.6 if cmap is SEQ_LIGHT else norm(v) < 0.4
            ax.text(j, i, fmt.format(v), ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6, color='white' if light else INK)
            if algos[i] == sel[t]:
                ax.add_patch(Rectangle((j - 0.5, i - 0.5), 1, 1, fill=False, ec=INK, lw=1.2, zorder=4))
    cb = fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.045, pad=0.03)
    cb.outline.set_visible(False)
    ax.set_title(title, loc='left')
    panel_label(ax, lab, x=-0.2)

Fig. 6 – SHAP summary (beeswarm) plots¶

In [22]:
FEAT = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('feat', ['#86b6ef', '#2a78d6', '#0d366b'])   # ordinal ramp: low -> high


def beeswarm(ax, phi, Xv, names, nbins=36, row_h=0.36):
    order = np.argsort(np.abs(phi).mean(0))
    for row, j in enumerate(order):
        x = phi[:, j]
        v = Xv[:, j]
        c = (v - v.min()) / (np.ptp(v) + 1e-12)
        bins = np.floor((x - x.min()) / (np.ptp(x) + 1e-12) * nbins).astype(int)
        off = np.zeros(len(x))
        for b in np.unique(bins):
            idx = np.where(bins == b)[0]
            idx = idx[np.argsort(x[idx])]
            for k, ii in enumerate(idx):
                off[ii] = ((k + 1) // 2) * (1 if k % 2 else -1) * row_h / max(4, len(idx)) * 1.6
        ax.scatter(x, row + off, c=FEAT(c), s=11, lw=0.3, edgecolor='white', zorder=3)
    ax.axvline(0, color=AXIS, lw=0.7, zorder=1)
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(order)), [names[j] for j in order])
    ax.grid(axis='y', visible=False)


fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 4, figsize=(W2, W2 * 0.3))
for ax, t in zip(axes, TARGETS):
    s = bb['shap'][t]
    beeswarm(ax, s['phi'], s['X'], [SHORT[f] for f in FACTORS])
    ax.set_xlabel(f'SHAP value ({UNITS[t]})' if t != 'TOPSIS' else 'SHAP value')
    ax.set_title(f"{SHORT[t]}" + (' (composite)' if t == 'TOPSIS' and bb['strategy']['choice'] == 'indirect' else f' ({sel[t]})'), loc='left')
sm = mpl.cm.ScalarMappable(cmap=FEAT, norm=Normalize(0, 1))
cb = fig.colorbar(sm, ax=axes, fraction=0.015, pad=0.01, ticks=[0, 1])
cb.ax.set_yticklabels(['low', 'high'], fontsize=6.3)
cb.set_label('Feature value', fontsize=6.8)
cb.outline.set_visible(False)
savefig(fig, 'Fig06_shap_beeswarm')
plt.show()

saved figures/Fig06_shap_beeswarm.png

9. Fig. 10 – Comparison with single-surrogate workflows¶

An earlier, preliminary analysis of the same data fitted a single Gaussian process surrogate to the TOPSIS score on the unscaled process parameters and maximised it with an evolutionary algorithm. Its local sensitivity curves are audited here with the same plausibility rule used by the Critic agent. The cell also refits the corrected single-surrogate workflow of the companion study (the same kind of GPR on standardised inputs with a normalised target) and evaluates it on the same scans, so that the three workflows can be compared (Fig. 10 and Table S5).

In [35]:
from sklearn.model_selection import LeaveOneOut, cross_val_predict

y_t = df.TOPSIS.values
band = (max(0.0, y_t.min() - cfg.oob_margin * np.ptp(y_t)), y_t.max() + cfg.oob_margin * np.ptp(y_t))
x_base = np.array([BASELINE['optimum'][f] for f in FACTORS])
comp = bb['composite']

# Corrected single-surrogate workflow (companion study): GPR on standardised inputs, normalised target
X_t = df[FACTORS].to_numpy(float)
def companion_gpr():
    kern = ConstantKernel(1.0, (1e-3, 1e3)) * Matern(1.0, (1e-2, 1e3), nu=2.5)
    return Pipeline([('scale', StandardScaler()),
                     ('gpr', GaussianProcessRegressor(kernel=kern, normalize_y=True, n_restarts_optimizer=10,
                                                      random_state=COMPANION['gpr_seed']))])
gpr_corr = companion_gpr().fit(X_t, y_t)
corr = gpr_corr.predict
q2_corr = r2_score(y_t, cross_val_predict(companion_gpr(), X_t, y_t, cv=LeaveOneOut()))
x_comp = np.array([COMPANION['optimum'][f] for f in FACTORS])


def local_ranges(predict, x0):
    """Range of the prediction within +-10% of each set-point (21 points, clipped to the bounds)."""
    out = {}
    for j, f in enumerate(FACTORS):
        g = np.linspace(max(LB[j], 0.9 * x0[j]), min(UB[j], 1.1 * x0[j]), 21)
        G = np.repeat(x0[None, :], len(g), axis=0)
        G[:, j] = g
        out[f] = float(np.ptp(predict(G)))
    return out


corr_range_own = local_ranges(corr, x_comp)          # at the companion optimum (panel c)
corr_range_pre = local_ranges(corr, x_base)          # at the preliminary optimum (Table S5)
rows = []
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(W2, W2 * 0.3), gridspec_kw=dict(width_ratios=[1, 1, 1.15], wspace=0.35))
for ax, f, lab in [(axes[0], 'Ton', '(a)'), (axes[1], 'Toff', '(b)')]:
    j = FACTORS.index(f)
    xb, yb = BASELINE['oat'][f]
    G = np.repeat(x_base[None, :], len(xb), axis=0)
    G[:, j] = xb
    ax.axhspan(band[0], band[1], color=GRID, alpha=0.7, lw=0, zorder=0, label='plausible band')
    ax.axhspan(y_t.min(), y_t.max(), color=tint(RESP_COLOR['TOPSIS'], 0.25), lw=0, zorder=0.5, label='observed range')
    ax.plot(xb, yb, color=PALETTE[7], lw=1.4, marker='o', ms=2.5, label='preliminary single GPR (unscaled inputs)', zorder=3)
    ax.plot(xb, corr(G), color=PALETTE[0], lw=1.4, ls='--', label='corrected single GPR (companion study)', zorder=4.5)
    ax.plot(xb, comp(G), color=INK, lw=1.4, label='agentic (audited) surrogates', zorder=4)
    ax.set_xlabel(LABEL[f])
    ax.set_ylabel('Predicted TOPSIS')
    ax.set_ylim(0, 0.8)
    ax.set_title(f'{lab} local scan around the preliminary optimum', loc='left', fontsize=7)
    rows.append(dict(Factor=f, earlier_min=min(yb), earlier_outside_band=float(np.mean((np.array(yb) < band[0]) | (np.array(yb) > band[1]))),
                     corrected_min=float(corr(G).min()), agentic_min=float(comp(G).min())))
h_, l_ = axes[0].get_legend_handles_labels()
fig.legend(h_, l_, fontsize=6.3, loc='lower center', ncol=5, bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.19), columnspacing=1.0)
ax = axes[2]
loc = bb['local_sensitivity'].set_index('Factor')
y = np.arange(len(FACTORS))[::-1]
ax.barh(y + 0.27, [BASELINE['local_range'][f] for f in FACTORS], height=0.25, color=PALETTE[7], label='preliminary', zorder=3)
ax.barh(y, [corr_range_own[f] for f in FACTORS], height=0.25, color=PALETTE[0], label='corrected (companion)', zorder=3)
ax.barh(y - 0.27, loc.loc[FACTORS, 'Range'].values, height=0.25, color=INK2, label='agentic', zorder=3)
ax.set_yticks(y, [SHORT[f] for f in FACTORS])
ax.set_xlabel('Range of predicted TOPSIS (±10% set-point)')

}, index=['Recommended setting', 'Predicted TOPSIS', 'Surrogate modelling', 'Validation',
